contract.modelContract: No model calls. Deterministic candidate proposed from the reproduced failing case; model/provider and evaluator inputs stay fixed.
contract.discoveryCase: toString must return a structured 404 instead of throwing
contract.primaryMetric: fraction of holdout HTTP requests returning structured NOT_FOUND and execution metadata
contract.noopMetric: fraction of holdout HTTP requests that fail to return the structured response
contract.gate: unmodified @metaharness/flywheel meetsPromotionRule; all anchor cases and existing tests must pass
contract.acceptance: holdout 4/4, anchor 4/4, existing and expanded tests pass, npm production audit has zero known vulnerabilities
contract.rollback: Revert the single implementation commit; the prior direct SCHEMAS lookup is restored.
contract.scope: one-line schema lookup hardening in the existing Cloud Function; no Rust, persistence, IAM, deployment, or package publication changes
contract.darwinBoundary: real-sandbox repo tests may not distinguish harness variants; Darwin output is reported separately and never substitutes for Flywheel source evaluation
